cassette: none: reducer.PostgresContainerImageIdentityWriter operates over []ContainerImageIdentityDecision Go values, not a CanonicalMaterialization; the two fixture decisions live inline in go/internal/replay/costcounting/container_image_identity_cost_test.go
description: Two canonical (CanonicalWrites=1) exact-digest decisions for distinct image references in one scope, driven through the production Postgres fact writer over an InstrumentedDB-wrapped counting fake. WriteContainerImageIdentityDecisions filters to CanonicalWrites>0 decisions then calls the shared reducerBatchInsertFacts bounded chunked bulk insert (go/internal/reducer/reducer_fact_batch_insert.go, batch size 1000): two rows fit one chunk, so the insert costs exactly 1 statement. It then issues containerImageIdentityRetireQuery, one set-based generation-authoritative DELETE that is O(1) in decision count, bringing the total to 2 — so eshu_dp_postgres_query_duration_seconds records 2 write observations and statements_executed=2. The per-decision bound this gate guards is unchanged: an N+1 write-per-decision regression scales the insert half with N and trips the budget, as the negative control (4 statements for the same two decisions) shows.
